description:
Port image.ts (~104 LOC) and terminal-image.ts. Display inline images in the TUI.

Implement:
- Terminal capability detection (Kitty vs iTerm2 vs sixel vs none)
- Kitty graphics protocol (base64 image data via APC sequences)
- iTerm2 inline images (OSC 1337)
- Cell dimension queries (CSI 16t) for proper sizing
- Fallback: show [image: filename] placeholder

Upstream: packages/tui/src/components/image.ts, terminal-image.ts
Depends on: terminal module, theme
title: Image rendering: Kitty/iTerm2 graphics protocol
